approaches.name: Linear scan
approaches.intuition: Look at every element until the target appears. It ignores that the array is sorted.
steps: Walk the array from the start
Return the index of the first match
approaches.time: O(n), too slow for the required O(log n)

approaches.name: Binary search
approaches.intuition: Sorted order lets one comparison discard half of the candidates.
steps: Compare the middle with the target
Shrink the range to the half that can still contain it
pitfalls: Infinite loops from `lo = mid` instead of `mid + 1`.
Overflow in `(lo + hi) / 2` in languages with fixed-size ints: use `lo + (hi - lo) / 2`.
Off-by-one on the loop condition: `lo <= hi` when `hi` is inclusive.

talkTrackMd: Say the invariant out loud: if the target exists, it is inside `[lo, hi]`. Then each step keeps that true while halving the range. Mention the overflow-safe midpoint.
